title: الهدية تبدأ بفكرة.
message: هذا تصور إبداعي تجريبي يستلهم المعلومات المعتمدة عن منتجات Lavish Perfumes، ولا يثبت اتجاهات سوقية أو نتائج استخدام.

shots.visual: Close opening on a blank matte-ivory typographic card with plenty of negative space. Use no physical gift box; typography alone implies consideration. Place approved PERLA product image as a small partial reveal in a secondary frame, intact. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Cut from black; fade in text over 180ms.

shots.visual: Scale up the approved PERLA 50ML UNISEX original product image from a wide ivory background with subtle 2D movement. Keep bottle and label undistorted; no invented packaging or bow. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: Position the same PERLA original centrally with a separate unbranded paper-shaped graphic in the background. The graphic is editorial only, not an included card or service. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: End on the original PERLA image and approved Lavish square logo as distinct, separate tiles with the CTA text below, not over the bottle label. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Hold final composition and fade to matte at exactly 15000ms.

caption: تصور إبداعي توضيحي لعلامة Lavish Perfumes، وليس دليلاً على اتجاه سوقي فعلي أو نتيجة استخدام مؤكدة.
